data: The course will present the concepts and methods of muItivariate analysis to the readers who have read at least one statistics course. The applications of multivariate methods is emphasized. The concepts of matrix algebra are very important. Matrices simplify the presentation of muItivariate techniques. Normal distribution and Regression models are discussed in the multivariate setup. Further, we introduce key concepts like principal component analysis, factor analysis, discriminant analysis and cluster analysis etc., which are quite relevant for data science.
